prose.text: The chunk's own entries come first, then the standard gate set in test-plan §3 order: `capability-drift` before the default-features workspace nextest, the `--features mcp-server` regen and the base-identity bindings close last, since no procedure is added. The two readings and the operator pass follow.

The readings fire at two different points of the work (inputs#I10). Before the first reading every non-leg entry is green except the candidate dry-run entry, which reads red, its baseline, until Step 7 builds the arms. Before the remedy reading, and again on the final tree, every non-leg entry is green. A stop after the first reading leaves that one entry red and the chunk pending; the plan is then revised on the operator's word.

Absences, each with its reason: - No `pulse-app/ui/**` path is touched, so the webview gates are absent and there is no headful self-verify. - No boot path is touched, so no boot-smoke entry is listed. The readings boot no app: the probe spawns `llama-cli`   itself, binds no port and opens no corpus (research.md; scope.md §Boundaries). - No local pre-push gate: `cargo xtask pre-push:linux` cannot run on this host; CI's `lint-test` job is the gate the   push meets. - No liveness probe keyed `round` precedes a reading: it drives no external process. Each reading's precondition is the   operator's slot entry before it, no `llama-cli` resident on the GPU. - No L4 latency grade: the probe emits no `metric.pipeline.l4.*` record, so that arm reads "not graded: no sample".

Each reading is two-armed by design. Exit 0 and exit 1 are both a completed, recorded verdict; exit 2 measured nothing. A reading's entry therefore asserts that the run completed and printed its verdict line, never an exit, and the verdict word is carried into the report's Outcome. NOT REPRODUCED and NONE are never reported as passed.

The mutation checks of Steps 4, 7 and 9 edit source and revert, so each is a ONE-SHOT run at implement, both readings in `evidence/mutation-checks.md`; the triage and probe unit entries guard the same properties on every re-run. The instruments this chunk builds, the reproduction rule and the remedy rule with its n sizing, meet their known-verdict controls before their one graded use: the Step 4 and Step 7 pins feed synthetic counts for each outcome through them in the probe unit entry, which precedes the reading each one grades.

The reproduction dry-run, the predecessor dry-run and the probe unit entry are written to be green from Step 4 on and after Step 9, and the scope guard names the chunk base. Evidence files are written by /implement from the entries' recorded outputs; each series' own files land under the gitignored `target/l4-decision-probe/`.
